declaration.goal: Crawl ahead by 0.3 to 0.5 m, keeping within 0.2 m of the start line and within 20 degrees of the start heading.
declaration.measured_by: Computed from the simulator's pose, as the quantities a camera straight above could measure; not measured from a camera image. The camera sees a floor area of 2.59 m by 1.46 m. x, y and heading are relative to the start of each trial: x in the direction the body faces at the start, y to its left, heading counter-clockwise seen from above, in (-180, 180]. At the start the body is at x = 0, y = 0, and the view spans x from -0.84 to 1.74 m and y from -0.73 to 0.73 m. A value is lost when the camera could not see the tracked point.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN all five inputs c0 to c4 are held at 0 for the whole trial, THE system SHALL end within 0.05 m of the start in x.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Zero input leaves the body at rest

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Zero input leaves the body at rest

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: T1 all zero: x=2.5e-5 m, inside range. Constant c0=1 (T2) and constant c1=1 (T3) also left the body at rest, so constant drive on c0 or c1 does not move it. Time-varying input is probably needed for crawling.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c0 = sin(2 pi t / 1 s) and c1 = cos(2 pi t / 1 s) at amplitude 1 and c2 to c4 are 0, THE system SHALL end at least 0.05 m from the start in x.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Quadrature sinusoids on c0 and c1 move the body

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Quadrature sinusoids on c0 and c1 move the body

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Predicted c0/c1 quadrature moves body by >=0.05 m; measured x=3.9e-5 m. c2/c3 quadrature (T5) moved only x=0.042, y=0.089, heading wobble +-10 deg. c4 alone: x=0.002. So c2 and c3 drive motion, c0 and c1 do not, and amplitude of progress is small at period 1 s.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 = sin(2 pi t / 2 s) and c3 = cos(2 pi t / 2 s) at amplitude 1 and c0, c1, c4 are 0, THE system SHALL end with x between 0.1 and 0.6 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Slower or reversed c2/c3 quadrature gives more forward travel

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Slower or reversed c2/c3 quadrature gives more forward travel

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Period 2 gave x=0.055, below the predicted 0.1 to 0.6. Period 0.5 gave x=0.144, y=0.161, heading -6 deg, so faster drive moves further. Reversed c3 sign at period 1 turned the body to 56 deg instead of crawling. Forward travel still well under 0.3 m.

statement.author: dr-kiro
statement.text: WHEN c2 = sin(2 pi t / 0.25 s) and c3 = cos(2 pi t / 0.25 s) at amplitude 1 and c0, c1, c4 are 0, THE system SHALL end with x between 0.2 and 0.6 m.

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Faster c2/c3 quadrature gives more forward travel

title.author: dr-kiro
title.text: Faster c2/c3 quadrature gives more forward travel

words.author: dr-kiro
words.text: Predicted x of 0.2 to 0.6 m at period 0.25; measured x=0.117 (y=0.139, heading 20 deg). Periods 0.33 and 0.2 gave x=-0.009 and 0.131. Faster than 0.5 s does not help. Best x overall is 0.144 m at period 0.5, short of the 0.3 to 0.5 m goal. Budget is spent; the last trial (T12) misses the goal.
